facebook.caption:
POV: you took a wrong turn in the jungle and ended up here.

Fairy Waterfall sits away from the beach crowds. 4.3 stars across 219 reviews. Most tourists never make it past the resorts.

Wear shoes you don't mind getting wet. Go early. The trail is worth every step.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
